<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons in the sample, I will first obtain its 13C NMR spectrum using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. The aromatic carbons typically appear in the 110–160 ppm region. By counting the distinct carbon signals in that region, I can infer the number of aromatic carbons present in the molecule.</thought>
